           <SET START <+ ,MOVES 1>>
           <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-COFFEE-START .START>)>
    <SET AGE <- ,MOVES <- .START 1>>>
    <COND (<L? .AGE 12> <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>
